craft_notes: Sthāyin: sought-unseen (whatever seen is you). Rows: row 2 (unseen→that). Close: that (tad as landing: THAT is you). Rejected: 'meditation' — kept sought (gaveṣita as searching, not sitting); 'everything is you' flat — kept whatever-is-seen (the seen, not all).

lines: Sought within the body by me always — you as self, yet the self unseen.
Seen, whatever is — you alone, that.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antardehe mayā nityaṃ tvamātmā ca gaveṣitaḥ | na dṛṣṭastvaṃ nacaivātmā yacca dṛṣṭaṃ tvameva tat

reads_against.argmap: What is found inside? → Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone — the sought turns out to be the seer.
c1_essence: Seeking finds no self to see: whatever is seen is you alone.
